title: Design data integration and analysis
learningObjective: Recommend a solution for data integration (Data Factory, Synapse pipelines, Fabric Data Factory, Event Hubs, Stream Analytics) and for data analysis (Synapse, Fabric, Databricks, Data Explorer, Power BI).
foundation: Data integration moves and transforms data from where it is created to where it is analysed.
Analysis turns that data into answers: reports, dashboards, predictions.
Pick tools by the job: scheduled batch copies, real-time streams, big-data processing or interactive dashboards.
engineer: Integration: Azure Data Factory (and Synapse pipelines) orchestrate ETL/ELT with 90+ connectors; integration runtimes: Azure IR (cloud), self-hosted IR (on-premises or private networks), Azure-SSIS IR (lift-and-shift SSIS packages); mapping data flows for code-free transformation. Microsoft Fabric includes Data Factory pipelines and dataflows in a SaaS platform. Streaming ingestion: Event Hubs (Kafka-compatible) and IoT Hub; Azure Stream Analytics for windowed SQL-like queries on streams.

Analysis: Azure Synapse Analytics (dedicated SQL pools for an MPP data warehouse, serverless SQL to query files in the lake, Apache Spark pools); Azure Databricks (Spark lakehouse for data engineering, data science and ML, Delta Lake); Microsoft Fabric (unified SaaS analytics on OneLake: lakehouse, warehouse, real-time intelligence, Power BI); Azure Data Explorer (fast KQL analytics on logs, telemetry and time series); Power BI for reports and dashboards.

Architecture patterns: medallion lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold layers in Data Lake Storage or OneLake), Lambda/Kappa for streaming plus batch, and Microsoft Purview for data catalogue, lineage and governance.

animation.caption: Pick the integration or analysis service for each data job.

example.title: A retailer's analytics platform
body: Data Factory copies nightly sales from on-premises SQL Server (self-hosted integration runtime) and SAP into the lake's bronze layer; Databricks cleans and joins it into silver and gold tables.
Store sensors stream through Event Hubs into Stream Analytics for real-time alerts; Power BI dashboards read the gold layer; Purview catalogues every dataset.

troubleshooting.symptom: Data Factory cannot reach an on-premises database.
troubleshooting.cause: Azure IR has no network path.
troubleshooting.fix: Install a self-hosted integration runtime on-premises.

troubleshooting.cause: Batch pipelines used for streaming data.

comparisons.difference: Data Factory orchestrates and copies; Databricks runs heavy Spark transformations and ML.
Synapse is PaaS you configure; Fabric is SaaS with OneLake and capacity-based billing.

misconceptions.reality: It moves and transforms data; it doesn't store it.
It processes streams and writes to outputs.

architectureDecisions: Data Factory for orchestration and copy (self-hosted IR for on-premises).
Databricks or Fabric for lakehouse processing; Synapse dedicated pools for MPP warehouses.
Event Hubs + Stream Analytics for real-time.

Analysis platforms: Databricks, Synapse, Fabric, Data Explorer

steps.label: Problem
steps.title: Data everywhere, answers nowhere
body: Sales are in on-premises SQL Server, stock in SAP, sensors stream every second, and managers want one dashboard.

steps.label: Batch
steps.title: Data Factory copies and orchestrates
body: Pipelines with connectors copy data on a schedule into the lake. A self-hosted integration runtime reaches on-premises sources.

steps.label: Stream
steps.title: Real time with Event Hubs and Stream Analytics
body: Event Hubs ingests millions of events per second; Stream Analytics runs SQL-like queries over time windows and raises alerts in seconds.

steps.label: Analyse
steps.title: Pick the analytics platform
body: Databricks: Spark for engineering and ML. Synapse: data warehouse and serverless SQL. Fabric: all-in-one SaaS with Power BI. Data Explorer: fast KQL over telemetry. Power BI shows the results.

steps.label: Recap
steps.title: Data integration and analysis
recap: Event Hubs + Stream Analytics for real time
